title: Utopia region renamed Galaxias Chaos after the second face

tellings.quote: And then they changed the name of the region from being just Utopia to Galaxis Chaos.

plain: John Brandenburg, a scientist who argues that life on Mars was wiped out by nuclear war, says that in the 1980s a second face-like shape was spotted on the Martian surface in a region called Utopia. He says that afterward the region's name was changed from Utopia to Galaxias Chaos. He tells it as a sign that the find was being played down.
